name: Coraza Integrated Technology Berhad
overview: Coraza 今年以 RM13,500,000 收购槟城 Nibong Tebal 的一幅土地及单层厂房连两层办公楼，用于扩大营运规模；其余公告主要为季度业绩、股东会议及附加上市（股份拆细）等事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增 20.1%，净利润同比增 69.8%。
overview_en: Coraza acquired a piece of land together with a single-storey factory and attached two-storey office building in Nibong Tebal, Penang, for RM13,500,000 to expand its operating capacity; other announcements were mainly quarterly results, shareholder meetings and additional listing (share subdivision) matters. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 20.1% year-on-year and net profit rose 69.8% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年主要事项为收购槟城厂房物业，以扩大营运规模。
segments.note_en: The main corporate event this year was the acquisition of a factory property in Penang to expand operating capacity.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Coraza Systems Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM13,500,000 现金收购槟城 Nibong Tebal 一幅土地及单层厂房连两层办公楼。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Coraza Systems Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. acquired a piece of land together with a single-storey factory and attached two-storey office building in Nibong Tebal, Penang, for RM13,500,000 in cash.
